title: What Chess Is About
transcript: This is what chess is all about. Playing in a tournament, I decide to play bishop E6. And my opponent makes a mistake going queen A3, allowing me to develop a knight with a threat of a fork, which eventually allows me to convert the initiative into a win. After the game, we discuss the position and I point out that queen A3 was a mistake by him. But the day after we are repaired against each other with the same colors and we follow up to playing the same exact line every single move the same way that we played it in the last game. And we eventually reach the same position that we had reached in the other game. Except that this time my opponent is wiser and decides to change his move and go queen C2 which is a big improvement. And eventually the game ends in a draw.
